reasons.action: The brief explicitly asks for a new behavior — the car pulling forward — which overrides the static showroom pose of the anchored reference frame; this is a requested performance, not merely a relocated subject.
reasons.medium: No rendering operation or target style is requested, so the live-action medium of the supplied actual-frame reference is preserved.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested, so the car's observed body properties (carbon fibre body) carry over from the reference unchanged.
reasons.lighting: "Out of the dark" describes where the car emerges from rather than an instruction about the light's source, direction or quality, and no illuminating practical is specified; the reference's showroom lighting therefore stands.
reasons.framing: The request contains no shot scale, viewpoint, composition or camera movement directive — forward motion of the car is subject action, not camera framing — so the anchored frame's composition governs.
reasons.palette: No colour grade, saturation or contrast treatment is requested; the incidental darkness in the phrasing does not authorize regrading the scene, so the reference palette governs.
